goal: Implement and evaluate topic-conditioned, distance-attenuated associative activation without abstraction-level or absolute node-depth restrictions.
allowed_scope: activation/firing/Recall implementations and directly related configuration, traces, tests and design documents
Do not alter provenance-owner path eligibility, persistent weights, Knowledge approval or unrelated F2-F8 policies.

criteria.requirement: A relevant cross-level path and a path with changed node depth metadata receive identical activation when other factors are equal.
For equal relevance/weights, activation attenuates with increasing distance from the selected focus; document the candidate distance metric and decay, proving convergence under supported parameters.
Near but irrelevant branches are suppressed while relevant indirect associations without literal query-token overlap can activate; distance alone is not relevance.
Positive negligible threshold and bounded scores terminate cyclic/dense graphs; reject invalid parameters and distinguish convergence termination from resource truncation in traces.
Exercise Python associative Recall, SQLite-backed natural-language Recall and offline browser fallback, or explicitly block completion on a missing route. Preserve provenance/view path contracts.
Existing Recall/evidence quality tests pass; no stored weights change on pure activation; fixed evaluator cases are not weakened.
